entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The personal affidavit of the Executive Engineer, Madhya Ganga Nahar, Nirman Khand-12, Aligarh filed in compliance of the order dated 29.03.2023 is taken on record.

It is submitted therein that since the petitioner and some other tenure holders did not accept the offer given by the department for compensation, as sale consideration for purchase of the land in question, the proposal dated 09.11.2022 had been sent to the State Government for acquisition of the land in question in accordance with the provision of Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The notification dated 17.02.2023 has been issued in this regard and the proceedings of acquisition are underway.

entities.text: Abdul Wasim vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having noticed the above fact, as the petitioner herein has approached this Court with the assertion that he may not be compelled to be part away with his land as he has not given consent for sale of the same, with the initiation of the acquisition proceedings, the prayer in the writ petition is rendered infructuous.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed as infructuous.
